description: FastAPI REST API serving a YOLO26n detector fine-tuned on the African Wildlife dataset, with tests and held-out metrics

release.title: v1.0.0: YOLO26n wildlife detector, hardened API, tests and measured results
release.notes:
First polished release on top of the original single-file demo.

### Highlights
- Default model: **YOLO26n fine-tuned on the public African Wildlife dataset** (buffalo, elephant, rhino, zebra). Held-out **test** split (227 images): mAP50 **0.975**, mAP50-95 **0.847** (`results/metrics_test.json`).
- `/predict` returns class, confidence and box per detection plus image size; `/predict/annotated` returns a JPEG with boxes drawn.
- Upload validation: 415 / 413 / 400 / 422 instead of HTTP 500; uploads decoded in memory (no shared `temp.jpg`).
- Blocking inference moved off the event loop; model loaded once with warm-up; config through env vars.
- Pinned requirements, a CPU-only Dockerfile (not yet built), 16 pytest tests, and a ruff + pytest GitHub Actions workflow.
- Training, evaluation and latency scripts, with every README number backed by a file in `results/`.

### Honesty note
The original `best.pt` was YOLOv8n fine-tuned on coco128, not YOLO26 on a custom dataset. It is kept as `models/yolov8n-coco128-demo.pt`, and its metadata is in `results/legacy_checkpoint.json`.

### Breaking change
The `/predict` response changed from `{boxes, classes}` to `{model, image, detections[], inference_ms}`. See CHANGELOG.md.
